answer: A Master's degree in Library Science from an American Library Association accredited college or university and seven years of professional library experience, with three of those in an administrative capacity in a moderate to large library system. Highly qualified candidates will have a second degree in Business, Public Administration or HR (Bachelor's or Masters) preferred, management experience in a public library system with multiple sites, successful experience with fundraising and library elections, experience providing library service to diverse communities. The ideal candidate is experienced in creating a positive people-centered, customer-service oriented culture, managing multiple branches in a diverse community, technology and library automation systems, using data to make decisions
